final: WITH f AS (SELECT orderslink, rebtotal, rebrate * 1.0 / feerate AS ratio FROM fees WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005 AND orderslink IS NOT NULL), per AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM f GROUP BY orderslink), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM per) SELECT per.orderslink, per.avg_rebtotal, per.avg_ratio, per.avg_ratio / m.mean_ratio AS rel_ratio FROM per CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rel_ratio IS NULL, rel_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
